messages:
Maya: Quick sync — we’re doing a microtest pass on the Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing variants next week. goal: tighten hero lines + map inbound lead routing for webinar signups. who’s in?
Jay: in. can we do a 3x2 matrix? (hero variant x CTA) — run for 72 hrs each.
Tony: count me in. note: Dedicated page needs explicit latency/SLA snippet, Private needs compliance/KMS mention. not just word salad.
Sarah: +1. I’ll own webinar CTA routing. want to map forms -> crm leadsource + webinar list. current funnel: /signup -> general leads. we should split: hosted-trial, dedicated-ps, private-contacts.
Olivia: proposing hero drafts: Hosted: "Start building with low-latency hosted inference" Dedicated: "Dedicated GPU capacity for predictable throughput" Private: "Private deploys with VPC & KMS control" feedback?
Maya: good direction. make Hosted more benefit-led (time-to-value). maybe: "Hosted API — launch features fast, zero infra"
Jay: love that. CTA matrix: [Get started] for Hosted, [Request reserved capacity] for Dedicated, [Contact sales — private deployment] for Private. set UTM campaign utm_campaign=landing_microtests_2026.
Tony: tagging edge cases: Dedicated CTA should open a short qual form (size, throughput req) before routing to AE. Private should route to SE + security intake.
Sarah: routing rules draft (will implement in HubSpot): 
```
- hosted form -> list: hosted-trial, leadsource=landing_microtests_2026_hosted
- dedicated form -> list: dedicated-pricing, leadsource=landing_microtests_2026_dedicated
- private form -> list: private-sales, leadsource=landing_microtests_2026_private
```
Olivia: copy microtests idea: keep two hero lengths: short headline + one-line subhead. e.g. Hosted headline: "Build with a production-grade hosted inference API" subhead: "Fast onboarding, predictable pricing, and curated open models."
Maya: timeline: draft copy by Tue EOD, internal review Wed AM, A/B setup Thu, launch tests Fri. can ops spin up tracking links? @Deploy Bot
Deploy Bot: scheduled snippet: tracking links & test routes will be created on Thu 09:00 UTC. I will post confirmation when done. :robot_face:
Jay: measurement plan: CTR -> conversion (form submit) -> demo/webinar signups. we'll track CPA per variant and qualitative feedback from heatmaps.
Tony: also test a 'feature callout' slot under hero for Dedicated: "SLA-backed latency, autoscaling pools" — keep short.
Sarah: noted. webinar mention: small banner in hero? maybe add subtle line: "Join our webinar: Serving LLMs at scale — May 12" with a separate CTA that goes to webinar list. split UTM utm_content=hero_banner.
Olivia: copy checklist for drafts: 1) one-line headline 2) 1-sentence subhead 3) primary CTA text 4) microcopy under CTA (privacy/commitment) 5) 1 feature bullet (25 chars) 6) tracking params.
Maya: owners: Olivia (copy), Sarah (routing + forms), Jay (experiment setup), Tony (dedicated feature bits). deliverables due Tue EOD.
Jay: can someone drop existing hero analytics? need baseline CTRs.
Maya: I'll grab baseline and post in channel later today.
Olivia: starting copy pass now, will post variants as comments.
Tony: +1, prepping dedicated snippet language with eng specifics for accuracy.
Sarah: will map HubSpot lists and test webhooks.
Maya: thanks team. small ask — keep language simple and measurable. less marketing fluff. :sparkles:
Olivia: got it. first pass by 17:30 PT.
Deploy Bot: tracking links created: https://redwood.test/track/abc123 (hosted), https://redwood.test/track/def456 (dedicated), https://redwood.test/track/ghi789 (private). will validate on Thu morning.
Maya: perfect — we’ll reconvene Thu 09:30 to review final variants.
Jay: :thumbsup:
Tony: :thumbsup:
